application.name: @gftdcojp/spirit-in-physics
application.description: Jung's Word Association Test Embedding Model for quantifying the human spirit.

processes.name: Consent & Setup
processes.description: Handles user consent and permissions. For local controlled studies, it uses a server-side process to manage files, eliminating user prompts for directory selection.

processes.name: Data Collection (2 Sessions)
processes.description: Core process where the user performs the word association test. Webcam and microphone are recorded continuously for the entire duration of each session.
steps: A continuous webcam and microphone recording begins for the session.
A stimulus word audio is played.
The system waits for a fixed 6-second response window.
The process repeats for all words.
At the end of the session, the continuous recording is stopped and saved.
After a break, the process is repeated for the second session.

processes.name: Live Event Logging
processes.description: Throughout each session, every significant event is immediately written to a session-specific log file.
processes.trigger: Any tracked event (e.g., session_start, word_displayed, response_window_closed).
steps: An event occurs in the client (e.g., a word is displayed).
The event, with a timestamp and details, is added to the zustand store.
The entire log from the store is immediately written to the session's log file (e.g., `session-1-log.json`) via the server-side API, overwriting the previous version.
This ensures the log file is always up-to-date, supporting session resumption.

components.name: JungVoiceTest
components.description: Handles the entire data collection flow, including continuous webcam/mic recording and triggering live logging for each event.

components.name: kawasakiStore
components.description: Zustand store that manages the session state and orchestrates all data saving operations by calling the server-side API for each event log and recording.

components.name: saveArtifactApi
components.description: Server-side API route that receives data from the client (video blobs, log files) and writes them directly to the `artifacts/sessions` directory on the local file system.

dataFlows.flow: Full Experiment Execution with Continuous Recording and Live Logging

steps.action: Continuous webcam and mic recording for Session 1 starts.
Dispatches 'logEvent' for 'session_start'. The entire log is immediately saved to `session-1-log.json` via the API.
(Loop) Stimulus audio plays. `logEvent` is dispatched for 'word_displayed'. Log file is updated.
(Loop) After 6 seconds, the next word is triggered. `logEvent` for 'response_window_closed' is dispatched. Log file is updated.
When Session 1 ends, the continuous recording is stopped.
The recording blob for Session 1 is saved to `session-1-video.webm` via the API. `logEvent` for 'session_complete' is dispatched. Log file is updated.
User clicks 'Start Session 2', repeating the process for the second session with new files (`session-2-video.webm`, `session-2-log.json`).
